newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stora in deal with Cascades.
newsitem.headline: Stora in deal with Cascades.

text.p: Swedish Stora said on Friday it was in a preliminary accord to sell its paperboard mill in Arnsberg, Germany to Cascades S.A., the French subsidiary of Canadian forest group Paperboard Industries International Inc.
Stora, the Swedish forestry group, said in a statement a final agreement was expected to be reached in July. It said the deal was so far a letter of intent.

It said operations at the Arnsberg unit, which is part of its Stora Paperboard division, focus was on recycled fibre-based White Lined Chipboard. The plant has a capacity of 135,000 tonnes annually, it said.
"The sale of Arnsberg is part of our work to improve the group's production structure and further concentrate the focus of our operations," Stora said in a statement.
"Since Arnsberg is the only Stora group unit producing recycled fibre-based board, coordination opportunities with the rest of the group are extremely limited," Stora said.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
